summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused ANPR perf verification found the direct _analyze_frame lazy contract is fixed, but the end-to-end cycle still eagerly encodes the HD frame thumbnail via _evaluate_scenarios() on every armed AI cycle even when no event/scenario is emitted. critical.issue: _evaluate_scenarios() calls _ensure_frame_thumb(result) unconditionally before checking whether any scenario alert will be inserted. Because _process_camera always calls _evaluate_scenarios and default arming is 'always', the HD frame thumbnail is still encoded on no-event cycles, preserving the ANPR responsiveness regression the lazy fix was meant to remove.

action_items: Move _ensure_frame_thumb(result) inside each _evaluate_scenarios branch immediately before _raise_scenario_alert, or use a local lazy getter so no thumbnail is encoded unless a scenario alert is actually emitted.
Retest no-event/no-alert AI cycles to prove _ensure_frame_thumb is not called, then rerun tests/test_iter28_lazy_thumb.py and the focused API/UI checks.
